title: ProjectSync
tagline: An autonomous Taskmaster AI Agent that turns shipped code into career assets in one click.
highlights: Engineered a 7-Node Directed Acyclic Graph agent workflow using Google ADK 2.0 to orchestrate multi-format career asset generation.
Implemented a dual-layer memory architecture combining Semantic Style Rules and an Episodic Transaction Ledger for style adaptation.
Designed a stateless backend on Google Cloud Run with Google Cloud Firestore integration to enable cooperative cancellation and resumption of pipelines.
